sample_marine_hits.isolation_source: the marine sediments of Kiaochow Bay, Qingdao

interpretation: Paper used 87 marine Streptomyces genomes (mostly NCBI). BV-BRC now indexes 14,474 Streptomyces genomes with multiple confirmed marine-source strains, so the dataset is reconstructible. Genome lengths (6.9-10.8 Mb) match the typical Streptomyces size range that drives the paper's 16-84 SMBGC count via antiSMASH.
